text:
Maya (Support): QuillCare raised a ticket asking for streamed completions that emit incremental function-call events to their webhook and a final validated JSON blob. They want downstream processing to begin on partials.

Jordan (Sales): Customer numbers: bursts ~420 qps, steady ~45 rps. They asked for <250ms per chunk. If we offer a beta SLA theyll sign an enterprise add-on.

Ethan (Product): Key clarifying Qs: webhook vs websocket? resume tokens on disconnect? server-side schema validation? DLQ behavior?

Maya (Support): Webhook preferred (HTTP POST events). They want resume_token support so a reconnect can resume without reprocessing. Server-side schema validation required and a final "finalized" event.

Riley (Eng): Technical notes: we stream tokens + final fncall today. To support partial fncall events we need explicit event framing (fncall.start, fncall.update, fncall.finish), resume tokens at checkpoints, and idempotency keys. Rough estimate: 2 weeks spec + 3-5 weeks implementation + 1 week SDK/docs + canary. Main risks: replay duplication on reconnect, ordering semantics, and webhook backpressure.

Priya (Security): Need webhook signing (HMAC), key rotation plan, and PII redaction options. Storing partial payloads needs privacy review.

Ethan (Product): Draft beta acceptance criteria:
- Deterministic event types: fncall.start / fncall.update / fncall.finish sent to webhook
- Resume token and idempotent replay semantics
- Final validated JSON with explicit server error codes on validation failure
- Webhook delivery: retry/backoff + dead-lettering behavior
- SDK helpers (Python/TS) for reconnect and replay
- Optional PII redaction hook and signed webhooks

Jordan (Sales): Customer requested 6 week timeline for beta. Can we commit to webhook-only beta in 6 weeks?

Riley (Eng): Webhook-only beta is possibly doable in 6 weeks if we limit to a single model family (v2.x) and skip on-prem. Full rollout (WS, DLQ UI, multi-model) 10-12 weeks. PII redaction adds ~3 business days for design + review.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4999 and assigned to Riley.

Ethan (Product): I'll mark this P0 for the sprint, draft acceptance criteria, and link INF-4999 to the roadmap card.

Riley (Eng): I'll start an RFC with event schemas and resume semantics. Need SRE sizing for webhook throughput and DLQ planning.

Priya (Security): I'll schedule a quick security/privacy review once RFC includes storage retention and sample events.

Maya (Support): I'll confirm with QuillCare if they can be the canary and whether the PII redaction must run in-line or can be a pre-delivery async job.

Sample event sketch (Riley):
POST /webhook/quillcare/events
Headers: { "X-Redwood-Event": "fncall.update", "X-Req-Id": "rq_2024_77" }
Body: {"request_id":"rq_2024_77","call_id":"c_7","event_type":"fncall.update","delta":{"path":"items[4]","op":"append","value":{"id":"it_12","status":"partial"}},"resume_token":"rtok_77","checkpoint":128}
notes: Beta scope: webhook-only, single model family, customer canary. Non-goals: websocket, on-prem, DLQ UI for beta.
